text: Product Features:

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Technology: Patented Solid State Electrochemical Hydrogen Sensor with Solid Electrolyte and Novel Reference Electrode.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Extremely Compact Design: Weighing less than 500 grams, overall.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Selective and Specific: to Hydrogen, even in multiple background gases.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Sub-second Response Time: T20 to T90 in 0.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Wide Operating Range: Options starting from ppm level to 10% H2 v/v.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Damage Resistant: Over-exposure of Hydrogen and high humidity.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Operating Life: 4-5 years

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Audio Visual Interaction: Local display, flashing red LED and buzzer.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Advanced Performance: Delivers high sensitivity, resolution, accuracy, and repeatability with fast recovery.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Long Duration Battery Backup: Fully charged battery delivers 24 hours of continuous operation.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Probe Extension: Custom length probe extensions can be configured with the device.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Easy Calibration: Quick calibration through computer interface.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Enclosure: IP65 ABS plastic enclosure.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Product Benefits and Comprehensive Service:

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Enhanced Safety: User can pin-point very low levels of leak at very early stages and act proactively to fix the leaks.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Enhanced Operator Efficiency: Checking leaks takes 10X less time compared to traditional H2 leak detectors, due to sub-second response and recovery time.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Design Advantage: Small and easy to handle. Extended and flexible probe design enables insertion of the probe into high or small and space constrained locations.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: No Damage on Over-Exposure: Sensor can be taken as close to the leak source as needed, without worrying about sensor damage.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

text: Saves operational cost: No false alarms avoiding unnecessary down time.

metadata.filename: MNST_NC2. Catalogue_PORTaHY H2 LD (Leak Detector Series).docx

rows.label: Start-Up Time
rows.value: 5 seconds warm up time.

rows.label: Response Time
rows.value: T20 to T90 in 0.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds

rows.label: Reading Update Time
rows.value: Readings update in every 1 second.

rows.label: Cross Sensitivity
rows.value: No cross sensitivity to other combustible and reducing gases

rows.label: Over-Exposure Impact
rows.value: No damage on short term exposure to even 100% pure Hydrogen In-house lab tested for 15 second exposure to 100% pure Hydrogen. In-house lab tested for 5 minutes exposure to 40% Hydrogen in Nitrogen. In-house lab tested for 10 minutes exposure to 20% Hydrogen in Methane.

rows.label: Operating Pressure
rows.value: 1 Bar to 1.2 Bar

rows.label: Operating Humidity
rows.value: Up to 99% RH at 40℃ (Non-condensing) for sensor probe.

rows.label: Storage Conditions
rows.value: 0℃ to +45℃. RH% < 90%. Store in a cool and dry place. Device must be stored in power OFF mode.

rows.label: Area of Deployment
rows.value: Safe Area/ Non-Hazardous Area.

rows.label: Power & Charger
rows.value: Piano switch to turn the device ON / OFF. Rechargeable battery operating at 3.7V with 1,150mAh capacity. Charger: Switch Mode, I/P 100- 300V AC, 50/60 Hz, O/P 5.5 V DC,750mA, Barrel Type (2 mm).

rows.label: Sleep Mode
rows.value: The device has a power saving feature to turn off the backlight upon 10 minutes of inactivity. Wake button can be used to bring the device into operating mode.

rows.label: Battery Support Period
rows.value: The device can operate for 24 hours continuously, when fully charged. Device must be switched OFF during charging.

rows.label: Display & Readout
rows.value: 4-line, graphical LCD display: Line 1: Selected FS range indication, over range indication and battery status Line 2: Tare status Line 3: Concentration readout of H2 in XXXX PPM or X.XXX % Line 4: Concurrent bar graph for %FS

rows.label: Audio Indication
rows.value: Internal buzzer with beeping frequency proportional to the concentration of Hydrogen sensed.

rows.label: Visual Indication
rows.value: Flashing red LED.

rows.label: Membrane Key Controls
rows.value: Multi-function membrane keyboard: 1. Arise from Auto-Sleep Mode 2. Highest reading in a cycle 3. Tare On/Off 4. Programmable memory switch 5. Toggling button 6. Selection button

rows.label: Display Enclosure
rows.value: Hand held display unit is a rugged and sleek plastic body with membrane keypad.

rows.label: Dimensions
rows.value: 165 mm x 85 mm x 30 mm

rows.label: Material of Construction
rows.value: ABS Plastic

rows.label: Weight
rows.value: ~ 220 grams

rows.label: Ingress Protection
rows.value: IP 65 as per IS/IEC 60529:2001

rows.label: Sensor Probe
rows.value: The sensor probe is made of light metallic front end, sturdy metallic neck and a plastic handle for ergonomic usage.

rows.label: Dimensions
rows.value: Ø24mm x 250mm (including the bent neck). Probe length can be customized as per requirement.

rows.label: Probe Connecting Cable
rows.value: 2 feet cable to connect the probe handle with the hand held display unit.

rows.label: Sensing Surface Position
rows.value: Sensor is housed at the tip of the probe for ultra-high sensitivity and suction free operation.

rows.label: Gas Exposure Method
rows.value: Diffusion. Gas exposure aperture Ø 3mm.

rows.label: Weight
rows.value: ~ 250 grams

rows.label: Calibration Interface
rows.value: In-built calibration routine controlled using the membrane keys. Zero and Span calibration can be performed using ambient air and certified calibration gas mixture (appropriate concentration of Hydrogen in appropriate background gas) respectively.

rows.label: Calibration Periodicity
rows.value: Recommended cycle: Once in every 6 months for high accuracy applications. Mandatory cycle: Once in every 12 months.

rows.label: Calibration Procedure
rows.value: The sensor can be calibrated within 5 minutes using our Gas Calibration Setup. Detailed procedure shall be shared along with the product.
